subject.title: fix(sessions): bound AGENTS.md and prompt-input file reads with size cap

question: Should upgraded projects with an existing AGENTS.md or CLAUDE.md above 1 MiB have their instructions skipped, or should the context-file path preserve the prior contract through a different bounded design?
rationale: The patch deliberately changes an existing user-visible session-input contract; choosing the cap and omission behavior requires product and compatibility intent rather than a mechanical repair.

options.title: Approve the 1 MiB skip contract
options.body: Land the cap with explicit session-owner approval and document that oversized project instructions are omitted with a warning.

options.title: Preserve existing project context
options.body: Keep the descriptor-bounded prompt-input protection but revise the project-context handling so existing oversized instruction files are not newly dropped without an approved migration or alternative.

options.title: Defer the context-file cap
options.body: Land only the prompt-input bound and track an owner-designed project-context limit separately.

recommendation.title: Preserve existing project context
recommendation.body: Keep the descriptor-bounded prompt-input protection but revise the project-context handling so existing oversized instruction files are not newly dropped without an approved migration or alternative.

likelyOwner.reason: The available context provides an adjacent repository ownership signal, while local history inspection was unavailable to identify a stronger session-area owner.
